question: Which source-selected bridges can the native a0 phase family, C/J E8 reconstruction and exact local compiler-complement dynamics jointly supply, and what remains unproved?
kills: Generating a determinant phase solely by smooth conjugation of the fixed simple-spectrum C6 clock or the fixed A3 cusp classfunctions.
Identifying the transported native C or J, or a nonidentity power, with a symmetry that preserves the chosen fixed microscopic U1 charge marking in the tested E8 edge reconstruction.
Treating the tested local compiler packet complement as a fixed-gap small J^2 correction: its energy splitting scales with J and lower-state complement weights remain finite.
Multiplying the two tested generic neighbouring zero-event projectors as a commuting global projector.
Embedding an affine E8 level-one current sector in an Ising-only unitary chiral sector with the same stress tensor, vacuum, adjoint and standard Sugawara/coset premises.
summary_de: PARTIAL: Bedingte a0/Yukawa-Viertelphase; echte C/J-Gitterlifts und gemeinsam invarianter E8-Energieblock; exakte lokale Komplement-Schliessung und Ueberlapprang 32/Kerndimension 18. Gemeinsame physische Quellabbildung bleibt offen.
scope: Algebraic results within pinned existing source models; no new physical choice of Yukawa connection, extra edge pair, energy symmetry, globally dressed chain or spacetime derived.
missing: Source-derived period-to-Yukawa bundle map and covariant determinant-line connection with regulated fermion measure and Higgs/basis transport.
Origin selection of the edge reconstruction, the massive pair and interaction; complete mixed-group microscopic clock lift and physical charge/time identification.
Overlap-compatible global state isometry and simultaneous transport of Hamiltonian, transfer term and local observables; charged low-energy field content.
A common physical source selecting all three structures.
not_derived: Global critical line or E8 current scaling limit of compiler chain
